workflow: A second invocation of the production Model SVG/PDF generator creates Extents, Window and browser-measured Display outputs from the shared fixture; pypdf, pdfplumber and Poppler inspect each output while independent scale and geometry mutations challenge the bytes.
result: The production outputs matched Chromium downloads byte-for-byte, were deterministic, changed under both mutations, contained zero skipped handles and zero image XObjects, and exposed the expected physical paper, clip and source-to-paper transforms.
